meta.source: Mathcad 15 funcdoc XML + Mathcad Prime function inventory

functions.name: acos
functions.description: Returns the angle (in radians) whose cosine is z. Principal value for complex z.

functions.name: acosh
functions.description: Returns the angle (in radians) whose hyperbolic cosine is z. The result is the principal value for complex z.

functions.name: acot
functions.description: Returns the angle (in radians) whose cotangent is z. The result is between 0 and pi if z is real, and the principal value if z is complex.

functions.name: acoth
functions.description: Returns the angle (in radians) whose  hyperbolic cotangent is z. The result is the principal value for complex z.

functions.name: acsc
functions.description: Returns the angle (in radians) whose cosecant is z. The result is the principal value for complex z.

functions.name: acsch
functions.description: Returns the angle (in radians) whose hyperbolic arccosecant is z. The result is the principal value for complex z.

functions.name: Adams
functions.description: Returns a matrix of solution values for the differential equation specified by the derivatives in D, and having initial conditions y on the interval [x1,x2], using Adams methods. Parameter intvls controls the number of rows in the matrix output.

functions.name: AdamsBDF
functions.description: Returns a matrix of solution values for the differential equation specified by the derivatives in D, and having initial conditions y on the interval [x1,x2], using BDF methods for stiff systems and Adams methods for non-stiff systems. Parameter intvls controls the number of rows in the matrix output.

functions.name: addnoise
functions.description: Returns matrix M with added noise, where the noise has probabilty p/2 to add n to a pixel, and p/2 to subtract n.

functions.name: Ai
functions.description: Returns the value of the Airy function of the first kind.

functions.name: Ai.sc
functions.description: Returns the value of the Airy function of the first kind, scaled by the factor Re(exp(2/3*z^(3/2))).

functions.name: and
functions.description: Returns the boolean AND of two image matrices M and N, which must be the same size.

functions.name: angle
functions.description: Returns the angle (in radians) from the x-axis to a line containing the origin (0,0) and the point (x, y). Results are in radians between 0 and 2ПЂ, excluding 2ПЂ. Both x and y must be real.

functions.name: anova
functions.description: Returns a table of statistics to examine the variance from the main factors, the blocking, and the error of an experiment that has its runs defined in the design matrix A and its results recorded in the matrix Y.

functions.name: APPENDPRN
functions.description: Writes the contents of an array M to the end of a delimited ASCII file.

functions.name: applybs
functions.description: Returns the result of applying the function f to each subband of the wavelet packet basis b comprising the coefficients in w. b is a 2- or 3-column matrix representing a packet basis.

functions.name: applytbl
functions.description: Returns a new wavelet packet table by applying the function f to each subband of the wavelet packet table T.

functions.name: arg
functions.description: Returns the principal argument of the complex number z, between -pi and pi, including pi.

functions.name: asec
functions.description: Returns the angle (in radians) whose secant is z. The result is the principal value for complex z.

functions.name: asech
functions.description: Returns the angle (in radians) whose hyperbolic secant is z. Result is the principal value for complex z.

functions.name: asin
functions.description: Returns the angle (in radians) whose sine is z. Principal value for complex z.

functions.name: asinh
functions.description: Returns the angle (in radians) whose  hyperbolic sine is z. Principal value for complex z.

functions.name: atan
functions.description: Returns the angle (in radians) whose tangent is z. Principal value for complex z.

functions.name: atan2
functions.description: Returns the angle (in radians) from the x-axis to a line containing the origin (0,0) and the point (x,y). Both x and y must be real.

functions.name: atanh
functions.description: Returns the angle (in radians) whose hyperbolic tangent is z. Principal value for complex z.

functions.name: augment
functions.description: Returns an array formed by placing A, B, C, ... left to right

functions.name: augment3
functions.description: Returns a matrix formed by putting matrices (or vectors) X, Y, and Z side by side. They must all have the same number of rows.

functions.name: bandpass
functions.description: Returns coefficients for a bandpass FIR filter with n coefficients and cutoff frequencies f1 and f2, windowed with a taper w.

functions.name: bandstop
functions.description: Returns coefficients for a bandstop FIR filter with n coefficients and cutoff frequencies f1 and f2, windowed with taper w.

functions.name: basis_display2d
functions.description: Creates a matrix for graphically displaying 2-dimensional basis b.

functions.name: BDF
functions.description: Returns a matrix of solution values for the stiff differential equation specified by the derivatives in D, and initial conditions y on the interval [x1,x2], using backwards differentiation formula methods. Parameter intvls controls the number of rows in the matrix output.

functions.name: bei
functions.description: Returns the value of the imaginary Bessel Kelvin function of order m.

functions.name: ber
functions.description: Returns the value of the real Bessel Kelvin function of order m.

functions.name: bessel
functions.description: Returns coefficients for an analog Bessel filter of order n; scale controls the gain at cutoff. The output is an argument to the functions iirlow, iirhigh, iirpass or iirstop.

functions.name: best_basis
functions.description: Returns the best packet basis from a packet table T, based on the additive cost function f.

functions.name: Bi
functions.description: Returns the value of the Airy function of the second kind.

functions.name: Bi.sc
functions.description: Returns the value of the Airy function of the second kind, scaled by the factor exp(-|Re(2/3*z^3/2)|).

functions.name: Bicubic2D
functions.description: Interpolates between 2-D values in Z, with locations in vx and vy, at intermediate point (p, q).

functions.name: binarize
functions.description: Returns a binarized version of matrix M with pixels above threshold thresh set to 1 and below to 0.

functions.name: binarize_auto
functions.description: Returns a binarized version of matrix M, choosing the threshold automatically.

functions.name: binarize2
functions.description: Returns a binarized version of matrix M with pixels between lowThresh and highThresh set to inValue, and pixels outside to outValue.

functions.name: Binterp
functions.description: Interpolates results b from Spline2 (b) at point x, along with the first, second, and third derivatives.

functions.name: bl
functions.description: Returns the Battle-Lemarie wavelet based upon the degree n cardinal B-spline. n is an integer bewtween 0 and 6.

functions.name: blackman
functions.description: Returns a Blackman window of width n.

functions.name: blend
functions.description: Returns a blend of same-size matrices M and N (pixelwise sum - [product/255]).

functions.name: block
functions.description: Returns the design matrix A with b blocks using default blocking generators. To specify the block generators directly, use "blockgen" instead of b.

functions.name: boxbehnken
functions.description: Returns an n factor Box-Behnken design matrix.

functions.name: boxplot
functions.description: Returns a matrix with the statistics of the data sets recorded in the columns of Data.

functions.name: boxplotgraph
functions.description: Returns a vector of two elements that you can use to generate box plots for the data sets recorded in the columns of Data.

functions.name: boxwilson
functions.description: Returns an n factor Box-Wilson design matrix (also called Center Composite Design, CCD).

functions.name: bspline
functions.description: Returns a vector of the coefficients of a B-spline of degree n for the data in vx and vy, given the knot values in u. The vector returned becomes the first argument of the interp function.

functions.name: Bspline
functions.description: Returns the analysis and synthesis low-pass filters for a spline-based biorthogonal wavelet. m is 1, 2, or 3. When m=1, n is an odd number between 1 and 5. When m=2, n is an even number between 2 and 8. When m=3, n is an odd number between 1 and 9.

functions.name: Bulstoer
functions.description: Returns a matrix of solution values for the smooth differential equation specified by the derivatives in D, and having initial conditions y on the interval [x1,x2], a Bulirsch-Stoer method. Parameter intvls controls the number of rows in the matrix output.

functions.name: burg
functions.description: Returns coefficients for nth order linear prediction generated from the vector v using Burg's method.

functions.name: butter
functions.description: Returns coefficients for an analog Butterworth filter of order n. The output is used as an argument to one of the functions iirlow, iirhigh, iirpass or iirstop.

functions.name: bvalfit
functions.params: v1, v2, x1, x2, xf, D, load1, load2, score
functions.description: Returns a vector of initial conditions for the boundary value problem specified by the derivatives in D where the solution is known at the intermediate point xf.

functions.name: canny
functions.description: Returns a binary edge image resulting from Canny edge detection on matrix M, using standard deviation sigma and hysteresis thresholds low and high.

functions.name: ccepstrum
functions.description: Returns a matrix containing the complex cepstrum of a multichannel signal A.

functions.name: ceil
functions.description: Returns the smallest integer greater than or equal to z.

functions.name: Ceil
functions.description: Returns the smallest multiple of y greater than or equal to z, typically used for correct unit scaling.

functions.name: center
functions.description: Returns fourier transform image matrix M tansformed so that DC is in the center.

functions.name: centsmooth
functions.description: Returns matrix M smoothed with a 3x3 center weighted kernel.

functions.name: cepstrum
functions.description: Returns the cepstrum of the vector v.

functions.name: cfft
functions.description: Returns the Discrete Fourier transform of any size vector or matrix of real or complex numbers. Returns an array of the same size as its argument.

functions.name: CFFT
functions.description: Returns the Discrete Fourier transform of any size vector or matrix of real or complex numbers.  Returns an array of the same size as its argument. Similar to cfft(A), with a different normalizing factor and sign convention.

functions.name: cheby
functions.description: Returns a Chebyshev window of width n and parameter b.

functions.name: cheby1
functions.description: Returns coefficients for a Type I Chebyshev analog filter of order n; ripple is controlled by the parameter e. The output is used as an argument to one of the functions iirlow, iirhigh, iirpass or iirstop.

functions.name: cheby2
functions.description: Returns coefficients for a Type II Chebyshev analog filter of ord. n with the lower edge of the stopband at scale and stopband attenuation atten. The output is an argument to the functions iirlow, iirhigh, iirpass or iirstop.

functions.name: Chi
functions.description: Returns the value of the hyperbolic cosine integral function. Can only be evaluated symbolically.

functions.name: chirpz
functions.description: Returns the frequency spectrum of the signal v between lo and hi at frequency intervals of d.

functions.name: cholesky
functions.description: Returns the lower triangular matrix L such that L times L transpose is M. L is the cholesky square root of the input matrix.

functions.name: Ci
functions.description: Returns the value of the cosine integral function. Can only be evaluated symbolically.

functions.name: clip
functions.description: Returns matrix M with elements clipped to lie between Min and Max.

functions.name: close
functions.description: Performs binary closing on matrix M at threshold b with structuring element Melem.

functions.name: cnorm
functions.description: Returns the cumulative probability distribution with mean 0 and variance 1.

functions.name: cnper
functions.description: Returns the number of compounding periods  for an investment to yield a specified future value.

functions.name: cnvxhull
functions.description: Returns a matrix containing the convex hull of pixels of value fg in matrix M.

functions.name: coherence
functions.description: Returns the coherence of vectors vx and vy. The signal vectors are divided into n overlapping intervals with fraction of overlap r. Each data segment is windowed with taper w.

functions.name: coiflet
functions.description: Returns the low-pass filter of the n-coefficient Coiflet wavelet. n is 6, 12, 18, 24, or 30.

functions.name: colgrad
functions.description: Returns the column gradient (difference by columns) of matrix M.

functions.name: cols
functions.description: Returns the number of columns in A.

functions.name: combin
functions.description: Returns the number of subsets (combinations) of k elements that can be formed from n elements.

functions.name: compgrad
functions.description: Performs edge detection by comparing the gradients of the 8 neighbors on matrix M.

functions.name: concat
functions.description: Returns the string formed by concatenating strings S1, S2, and so on.

functions.name: concomp
functions.description: Performs connected component labeling of the pixels with grayscale value fg in matrix M, considering 4-connected neighbors if con is 4 or 8-connected if con is 8.

functions.name: cond1
functions.description: Returns the condition number of the matrix M based on the L1 norm.

functions.name: cond2
functions.description: Returns the condition number of the matrix M based on the L2 norm.

functions.name: conde
functions.description: Returns the condition number of the matrix M based on the Euclidean norm.

functions.name: condi
functions.description: Returns the condition number of the matrix M based on the infinity norm.

functions.name: confidence
functions.description: Returns the confidence limits on the parameters b of a fitting function F(x,b) fit to the data vx and vy.

functions.name: contingtbl
functions.description: Returns chi-squared, degrees of freedom, probability that chi-squared or larger would occur if variables had no association, Cramer's V, and the contingency coefficient, C for a contingency table M.

functions.name: convol
functions.description: Returns the convolution of the arrays vx and vy.

functions.name: convol2d
functions.description: Returns the convolution of matrix M with kernel K.

functions.name: convolve3
functions.description: Returns the quick convolution of matrix M with 3x3 kernel K.

functions.name: convolve5
functions.description: Returns the quick convolution of matrix M with 5x5 kernel K.

functions.name: corr
functions.description: Returns the Pearson's r correlation coefficient of the elements in A and B.

functions.name: correl
functions.description: Returns the correlation of vectors vx and vy. Result is a vector for which each element contains the summed vector product of vx and a shifted version of vy.

functions.name: correl2d
functions.description: Returns the 2D correlation of matrix M with kernel K. The resulting matrix contains the summed element-wise  product of K overlapped with a subset of M.

functions.name: cos
functions.description: Returns the cosine of z.

functions.name: cosh
functions.description: Returns the hyperbolic cosine of z.

functions.name: costaper
functions.description: Returns a cosine taper window of length n, with the percentage of raised cosine given by a.

functions.name: costr
functions.description: Returns the cosine transform of the array v.

functions.name: cot
functions.description: Returns the cotangent of z.

functions.name: coth
functions.description: Returns the hyperbolic cotangent of z.

functions.name: covar
functions.description: Returns the covariance of the arrays vx and vy.

functions.name: cpt
functions.description: Returns the n-level local cosine packet table for the data array a, using the default trig data taper function.

functions.name: crate
functions.description: Returns the fixed interest rate per period required for an investment at present value to yield a specified future value over a number of compounding periods.

functions.name: create_level
functions.description: Returns a d-dimensional wavelet packet basis of all wavelet packets at the level n.

functions.name: CreateMesh
functions.description: Returns a nested array of three matrices representing the x-, y-, and z-coordinates of a parametric surface defined by the function(s) of two variables in the first argument(s).

functions.name: CreateSpace
functions.description: Returns a nested array of three vectors representing the x-, y-, and z-coordinates of a space curve defined by the function(s) of one variable in the first argument.

functions.name: csc
functions.description: Returns the cosecant of z.

functions.name: csch
functions.description: Returns the hyperbolic cosecant of z.

functions.name: csgn
functions.description: Returns the complex sign of z, given by 0 if z = 0, 1 if the real or imaginary part of z is > 0, and -1 otherwise.

functions.name: csort
functions.description: Returns an array formed by rearranging rows of A until column n is in ascending order.

functions.name: cspectrum
functions.description: Returns the cross spectrum of the vectors vx and vy. The signal vectors are divided into n overlapping intervals with fraction of overlap r. Each data segment is windowed with taper w.

functions.name: cspline
functions.description: Returns a vector of cubic spline coefficients with cubic endpoints which fits the independent data in vector or matrix vx and dependent data in vy. This vector becomes the first argument of the interp function.

functions.name: cumint
functions.description: Returns the cumulative interest paid on a loan between a starting period and an ending period given a fixed interest rate, the total number of compounding periods, and the present value of the loan.

functions.name: cumprn
functions.description: Returns the cumulative principal paid on a loan between a starting period and an ending period given a fixed interest rate, the total number of compounding periods, and the present value of the loan.

functions.name: cvar
functions.description: Returns the covariance of the elements in A and B.

functions.name: cyl2xyz
functions.description: Converts the cylindrical coordinates of a point (r, theta, z) to rectangular coordinates (x, y, z).

functions.name: DAi
functions.description: Returns the value of the first derivative of the Airy function of the first kind.

functions.name: DAi.sc
functions.description: Returns the value of the first derivative of the Airy function of the first kind, scaled by the factor Re(exp(2/3*z^(3/2))).

functions.name: daublet
functions.description: Returns the low-pass filter of the n-coefficient minimum phase Daubechies wavelet. n is an even integer between 2 and 20.

functions.name: dbeta
functions.description: Returns the probability density for the beta distribution with shape parameters s1 and s2.

functions.name: DBi
functions.description: Returns the value of the first derivative of the Airy function of the second kind.

functions.name: DBi.sc
functions.description: Returns the value of the first derivative of the Airy function of the second kind, scaled by the factor exp(-|Re(2/3*z^3/2)|).

functions.name: dbinom
functions.description: Returns the probability density for the Binomial distribution.

functions.name: dcauchy
functions.description: Returns the probability density for the Cauchy distribution with location l and scale s.

functions.name: dchisq
functions.description: Returns the probability density for the chi-squared distribution with degrees of freedom d.

functions.name: dct2d
functions.description: Returns the 2D discrete cosine transform (type II) of matrix M.

functions.name: deconvol
functions.description: Returns the deconvolution of the array vz by the array vx.

functions.name: denom
functions.description: Returns the denominator of the fraction or rational expression x. Can only be evaluated symbolically.

functions.name: detrend
functions.description: Returns the vector or matrix v with any linear trend removed.

functions.name: dexp
functions.description: Returns the probability density for the exponential distribution with rate of decay r.

functions.name: dF
functions.description: Returns the probability density for the F distribution with degrees of freedom d1 and d2.

functions.name: dgamma
functions.description: Returns the probability density for the gamma distribution with shape parameter s.

functions.name: dgeom
functions.description: Returns the probability density for the Geometric distribtuion, with probability of success p.

functions.name: dht
functions.description: Returns the Hartley transform of the array v.

functions.name: dhypergeom
functions.description: Returns the probability density for the hypergeometric distribution.

functions.name: diacrisp
functions.description: Returns matrix M crisped with a 3x3 diagonally weighted kernel.

functions.name: diag
functions.description: Returns a matrix containing on its diagonal the elements of v.

functions.name: difedge
functions.description: Performs edge-detection by differential convolution on matrix M.

functions.name: dilate
functions.description: Performs binary dilation on matrix M at threshold b using structuring element Melem with origin at row r_origin and column c_origin.

functions.name: dilate4
functions.description: Performs dilation on matrix M at threshold b using 4 neighbors.

functions.name: dilate8
functions.description: Performs dilation on matrix M at threshold b using 8 neighbors.

functions.name: dilog
functions.description: Returns the value of the dilogarithm function. Can only be evaluated symbolically.

functions.name: distform
functions.description: Returns the distance transform of image M using foreground gray value fg.

functions.name: dlfather
functions.description: Returns the value at x of the dual father wavelet packet based on the filter represented by string s at scale j and position k. If j and k are omitted, they are assumed to be 0.

functions.name: dlfather2d
functions.description: Returns the value at (x,y) of the 2D dual father wavelet packet based on the filter represented by string s at scale j and position (kx,ky). If j, kx, and ky are omitted, they are assumed to be 0.

functions.name: dlmother
functions.description: Returns the value at x of the dual mother wavelet packet based on the filter represented by string s at scale j and position k. If j and k are omitted, they are assumed to be 0.

functions.name: dlmother2d
functions.params: x, y, [j, kx, ky], s, ds
functions.description: Returns the value at (x,y) of the 2D dual mother wavelet packet based on the filter represented by string s at scale j and position (kx,ky). String ds is either "H", "V", or "D", and indicates either the horizontal, vertical, or diagonal mother wavelet. If j, kx, and ky are omitted, they are assumed to be 0.

functions.name: dlnorm
functions.description: Returns the probability density for the lognormal distribution with logmean mu and logdeviation sigma.

functions.name: dlogis
functions.description: Returns the probability density for the logistic distribution with location l and scale s.

functions.name: dlwavelet
functions.description: Returns the value at x of the nth dual wavelet packet based on the filter f at scale j and position k. f is either a vector or a 2-column matrix. f can have an offset o and negation i.

functions.name: dlwavelet2d
functions.params: x, y, j, kx, ky, m, n, f, [o, [i]]
functions.description: Returns the value at (x,y) of the (m,n)th dual wavelet packet based on filter f at scale j and position (kx,ky). f is either a vector or a 2-column matrix. f can have an offset o and negation i.

functions.name: DMS
functions.description: Returns the angle in radians given a vector containing degrees, minutes, and seconds; or returns the vector given the angle when used in the units placeholder.

functions.name: dnbinom
functions.description: Returns the probability density for the negative binomial distribution with size n and probability of failure p.

functions.name: dnorm
functions.description: Returns the probability density for the normal distribution with mean mu and standard deviation sigma.

functions.name: doelabel
functions.description: Replaces the labeling and the coding of the design matrix A with the labels and values recorded in the matrix Vals.

functions.name: dpois
functions.description: Returns the probability density for the Poisson distribution in which mean l.

functions.name: dt
functions.description: Returns the probability density for Student's t distribution with degrees of freedom d.

functions.name: dunif
functions.description: Returns the probability density for the uniform distribution on an interval [a,b].

functions.name: dwavelet
functions.description: Returns a discrete wavelet transform of the array v.

functions.name: dweibull
functions.description: Returns the probability density for the Weibull distribution with shape parameter s.

functions.name: DWS
functions.description: Returns the Durbin-Watson statistic for the result vector, b, of the Spline2 function.

functions.name: dwt
functions.description: Returns the n-level wavelet transform of the array a by the wavelet filter f. f is either a vector or a 2-column matrix. f can have an offset o and negation i.

functions.name: dwti
functions.description: Returns the n-level interval wavelet transform of the array a by the wavelet filter f. f is a vector returned by daublet or symmlet.

functions.name: dwts
functions.description: Returns the n-level symmetric wavelet transform of the array a by the wavelet filter f. f is either a vector or a 2-column matrix returned by bl, Bspline, or daublet(2).

functions.name: eff
functions.description: Returns the effective annual interest rate (APR), given the nominal interest rate and the number of compounding periods per year.

functions.name: effects
functions.description: Returns the level effects associated with each main factor and with blocking of an experiment that has its runs defined in the design matrix A and its results recorded in the matrix Y.

functions.name: effectsgraph
functions.description: Returns a vector of two elements that you can use to generate an effects plot for Q, the output of the quickscreen function.

functions.name: Ei
functions.description: Returns the value of the exponential integral function.

functions.name: eigenvals
functions.description: Returns a vector of eigenvalues for the square matrix M.

functions.name: eigenvec
functions.description: Returns the normalized eigenvector associated with eigenvalue z of the square matrix M. The eigenvector is normalized to unit length.

functions.name: eigenvecs
functions.description: Returns a matrix containing the normalized eigenvectors corresponding to the eigenvalues of the square matrix M. The nth column of the matrix returned is an eigenvector corresponding to the nth eigenvalue returned by eigenvals. Optional last argument "L" specifies the left eigenvalue.

functions.name: equalize
functions.description: Returns matrix M with grayscale adjusted to form a linear cumulative histogram.

functions.name: erf
functions.description: Returns the error function.

functions.name: erfc
functions.description: Returns the complementary error function.

functions.name: erode
functions.description: Performs binary erosion on matrix M at threshold b using structuring element Melem with origin at row r_origin and column c_origin.

functions.name: erode4
functions.description: Performs erosion on matrix M at threshold b using 4 neighbors.

functions.name: erode8
functions.description: Performs erosion on matrix M at threshold b using 8 neighbors.

functions.name: error
functions.description: Returns the string S as a Mathcad error tip.

functions.name: evalbs
functions.description: Returns the result of applying the function f to each subband of the wavelet packet basis b comprising the coefficients in w. b is a 2- or 3-column matrix representing a packet basis.

functions.name: evaltbl
functions.description: Returns the result of applying the function f to each subband of the wavelet packet table T.

functions.name: exp
functions.description: Returns the number e raised to the power z.

functions.name: expfit
functions.description: Returns a vector containing three coefficients for an exponential curve of the form a*e^(b*x)+c that best approximates the data in vectors vx and vy. The optional vector vg contains guess values for the three coefficients.

functions.name: expsmooth
functions.description: Returns a smoothed version of data in array v generated by exponential smoothing with weight a.

functions.name: extract
functions.description: Returns the nth (1, 2, or 3) color component of packed 3-color matrix M.

functions.name: extract_basis
functions.description: Returns coefficients in the basis specified by b from a 1D or 2D packet table T.

functions.name: father
functions.description: Returns the value at x of the father wavelet packet based on the filter represented by string s at scale j and position k. If j and k are omitted, they are assumed to be 0.

functions.name: father2d
functions.description: Returns the value at (x,y) of the 2D father wavelet packet based on the filter represented by string s at scale j and position (kx,ky). If j, kx, and ky are omitted, they are assumed to be 0.

functions.name: fft
functions.description: Returns the fast Fourier transform of real data vector v with 2^n elements. Returns a vector of size 2^n-1 + 1.  Similar to FFT(v), except uses a different normalizing factor and sign convention.

functions.name: FFT
functions.description: Returns the fast Fourier transform of real data vector v with 2^n elements. Returns a vector of size 2^n-1 + 1. Similar to fft(v), except uses a different normalizing factor and sign convention.

functions.name: fftfilt
functions.description: Returns a matrix with the result of the convolution of a multichannel signal v, with an array C, calculated by computing the FFT of length nfft.

functions.name: fhyper
functions.description: Returns the value of the Gauss hypergeometric function at the point x given parameters a, b, c.

functions.name: FIF
functions.description: Returns a length given a string representing feet-inches-fractions; or returns the FIF string given a length when used in the units placeholder.

functions.name: filterNaN
functions.description: Removes the rows of the data set, v, that have NaNs.

functions.name: Find
functions.description: Returns the values of var1, var2, ..., that solve a system of equations in a Solve Block. Returns a scalar if there is only one argument, otherwise returns a vector of answers.

functions.name: floor
functions.description: Returns the greatest integer less than or equal to z.

functions.name: Floor
functions.description: Returns the greatest multiple of y less than or equal to z, typically used for correct unit scaling.

functions.name: foldover
functions.description: Returns a 2-block design matrix with twice the number of runs as the design matrix A.

functions.name: format
functions.description: Returns a string containing the value of the arguments x, y, z, ... with print order and surrounding text specified by S. S is optional if only one value is printed.

functions.name: fractalias
functions.description: Returns a matrix with all the aliased interactions for each factor and interaction specified in "fac", based on the string of design generators "gen".

functions.name: fractfact
functions.description:
Returns a 2-level fractional factorial design matrix generated from default generators for fractional factorials with n factors and 2n-r runs. 
You can also enter this function as fractfact("gen"). In that case you specify the generators in the string "gen".

functions.name: fractresol
functions.description: Returns the resolution of a fractional factorial design matrix defined by the string of design generators "gen".

functions.name: fractruns
functions.description: Returns the number of runs in a fractional factorial design matrix defined by the string of design generators "gen".

functions.name: freichen
functions.description: Performs edge detection by Frei-Chen convolution on matrix M.

functions.name: FresnelC
functions.description: Returns the value of the Fresnel cosine integral function.

functions.name: FresnelS
functions.description: Returns the value of the Fresnel sine integral function.

functions.name: Ftest
functions.description: Tests the hypothesis that v1 and v2 are drawn from distributions having the same variance. Returns the F statistic, and the probability that a value this large or larger would occur when the distributions have the same variance.

functions.name: fullfact
functions.description: Returns an n factor full factorial design matrix with two levels per factor unless specified otherwise in the levels vector.

functions.name: funcdeconv
functions.description: Deconvolution of matrix M with frequency domain function f and error e.

functions.name: funconv
functions.description: Convolution of matrix M with frequency domain function f.

functions.name: funmap
functions.description: Returns matrix M with function f applied to each element.

functions.name: fv
functions.description: Returns the future value of an investment or loan given a periodic, constant payment and a fixed interest rate.

functions.name: fvadj
functions.description: Returns the future value of an initial principal after applying the series of compound interest rates in vector v.

functions.name: fvc
functions.description: Returns the future value of a vector of cash flows, v, earning a specified interest rate.

functions.name: gain
functions.description: Returns the gain at frequency f of a filter with coefficients C.

functions.name: gaussconv
functions.description: Convolution of matrix M with frequency domain gaussian of half-width s.

functions.name: gaussdeconv
functions.description: Deconvolution of matrix M with frequency domain gaussian of half-width s with error e.

functions.name: gaussian
functions.description: Returns a Gaussian window of width n; the parameter a controls the peak width.

functions.name: gaussn
functions.description: Returns an n-element vector of random numbers following a Gaussian probability distribution of mean 0 and standard deviation 1.

functions.name: gcd
functions.description: Returns the greatest common divisor: the largest integer that evenly divides all the elements of A, B, C, ...

functions.name: genfit
functions.description: Returns a vector of parameters that make the first function in the vector F best fit the data in the vectors vx and vy. The remaining elements in F are partial derivatives of the fitting function with respect to its n parameters, and vg is a vector of guess values. Right-click on this function to choose a solver.

functions.name: geninv
functions.description: Returns the generalized (pseudo) inverse of the input matrix A, giving the least-squares solution to a system of equations..

functions.name: genvals
functions.description: Returns a vector of computed eigenvalues, vi, each of which satisfies the generalized eigenvalue problem MВ·x = viВ·NВ·x for its associated eigenvector xi.

functions.name: genvecs
functions.description: Returns a matrix of normalized eigenvectors corresponding to the eigenvalues returned by genvals. Optional last argument "L" specifies the left eigenvalue.

functions.name: get_detail
functions.description: Returns the result of extracting the index-1 block of wavelet packet coefficients at level l from the wavelet packet transform w.

functions.name: get_detail2d
functions.description: Returns the result of extracting the subband indicated by the string ds of wavelet packet coefficients at level l from the 2-dimensional wavelet packet transform M. ds is either "H", "V", or "D", and indicates either the index-(1,0), index-(0,1), or index-(1,1) subband.

functions.name: get_smooth
functions.description: Returns the result of extracting the 0th block of wavelet packet coefficients at level l from the wavelet packet transform w.

functions.name: get_smooth2d
functions.description: Returns the result of extracting the (0,0)th subband of wavelet packet coefficients at level l from the 2-dimensional wavelet packet transform M.

functions.name: get_subband
functions.description: Returns the nth block of wavelet packet coefficients at level l extracted from the wavelet packet transform w. w is a vector.

functions.name: get_subband2d
functions.description: Returns the result of extracting the (m,n)th subband of wavelet packet coefficients at level l from the 2-dimensional wavelet packet transform M. M is an array.

functions.name: getnoise
functions.description: Returns the difference between matrix M and median filtered M.

functions.name: GETWAVINFO
functions.description: Returns a vector containing, in order, the number of channels, the sample rate, the bit resolution, and the average bytes per second for a WAV file.

functions.name: gmean
functions.description: Returns the geometric mean of the elements of A, B, C, ...

functions.name: gray_close
functions.description: Performs grayscale closing on matrix M with structuring element Melem.

functions.name: gray_dilate
functions.description: Performs grayscale dilation on matrix M using structuring element Melem with origin at row r_origin and column c_origin.

functions.name: gray_erode
functions.description: Performs grayscale erosion on matrix M using structuring element Melem with origin at row r_origin and column c_origin.

functions.name: gray_open
functions.description: Performs grayscale opening on matrix M with structuring element Melem.

functions.name: gray_to_rgb
functions.description: Returns grayscale matrix gray converted to color using color palette matrix colormap.

functions.name: Grubbs
functions.description: Returns indices of suspected outliers, and their Grubbs test statistics for a confidence level a.

functions.name: GrubbsClassic
functions.description: Returns index of the data point most likely to be an outlier, and its Grubbs test statistic for a confidence level a.

functions.name: H1
functions.description: Returns the Hankel function of the first kind (Bessel function of the third kind).

functions.name: H1.sc
functions.description: Returns the Hankel function of the first kind (Bessel function of the third kind), scaled by the factor exp(-z*i).

functions.name: H2
functions.description: Returns the Hankel function of the second kind (Bessel function of the third kind).

functions.name: H2.sc
functions.description: Returns the Hankel function of the second kind (Bessel function of the third kind), scaled by the factor exp(z*i).

functions.name: hamming
functions.description: Returns a Hamming window of width n.

functions.name: hanning
functions.description: Returns a Hanning window of width n.

functions.name: Her
functions.description: Returns the value of the Hermite polynomial of degree n at x.

functions.name: hhmmss
functions.description: Returns a time given a string containing hours:minutes:seconds; or returns the string given a time when used in the units placeholder.

functions.name: highpass
functions.description: Returns coefficients for a highpass FIR filter with n coefficients and cutoff frequency f, windowed with taper w.

functions.name: hilbert
functions.description: Returns the Hilbert transform of the array v.

functions.name: hist
functions.description: Returns a vector representing the frequencies with which values in data fall into the intervals represented by intvls. intvls can be a vector of interval endpoints, or an integer number of subintervals of equal length.

functions.name: hist2d
functions.description: Returns a two-dimensional histogram with n bins on equal-sized matrices M and N.

functions.name: histogram
functions.description: Returns a two-column matrix containing the midpoints of the intvls subintervals. The second column is identical to the vector returned by hist. The resulting matrix has intvls rows.

functions.name: Hlookup
functions.description: Looks in the first row of A for values matched by z according to the boolean modifier. Returns the value(s) in the matched column(s) in row r.

functions.name: hlookup
functions.description: Looks in the first row of a matrix, A, for a given value, z, and returns the value(s) in the same column(s) in the row specified, r. When multiple values are returned, they appear in a vector.

functions.name: hls_to_rgb
functions.description: Returns array HLS in HLS color representation converted to RGB color representation.

functions.name: hmean
functions.description: Returns the harmonic mean of the elements of A, B, C, ...

functions.name: horzflip
functions.description: Returns the matrix M flipped horizontally.

functions.name: hsv_to_rgb
functions.description: Returns array HSV in HSV color representation converted to RGB color representation.

functions.name: I0
functions.description: Returns the zeroth order modified Bessel function of the first kind.

functions.name: I0.sc
functions.description: Returns the zeroth order modified Bessel function of the first kind, scaled by the factor exp(-|Re(z)|).

functions.name: I1
functions.description: Returns the first order modified Bessel function of the first kind.

functions.name: I1.sc
functions.description: Returns the first order modified Bessel function of the first kind, scaled by the factor exp(-|Re(z)|).

functions.name: ibeta
functions.description: Returns the value of the incomplete beta function of x and y with parameter a.

functions.name: icfft
functions.description: Returns the inverse Fourier transform corresponding to cfft. Returns an array of the same size as its argument.

functions.name: ICFFT
functions.description: Returns the inverse Fourier transform corresponding to CFFT. Returns an array of the same size as its argument.

functions.name: icostr
functions.description: Returns the inverse cosine transform of the array v.

functions.name: icpt
functions.description: If w is an array of cosine packet coefficients constructed from a cosine packet table with n levels, returns the inverse cosine packet transform with respect to the basis specified by b, using the default trig data taper function. b is a 2- or 3-column matrix representing a cosine packet basis.

functions.name: idct2d
functions.description: Returns the inverse 2D discrete cosine transform (type II) of matrix M.

functions.name: identity
functions.description: Returns an n x n identity matrix (a matrix of 0's with 1's along the diagonal).

functions.name: idht
functions.description: Returns the inverse Hartley transform of the array v.

functions.name: idwavelet
functions.description: Returns the inverse of the discrete wavelet transform carried out by the dwavelet function.

functions.name: idwt
functions.description: Returns the n-level inverse wavelet transform of the array a by the wavelet filter f. f is either a vector or a 2-column matrix. f can have an offset o and negation i.

functions.name: idwti
functions.description: Returns the n-level inverse interval wavelet transform of the array a by the wavelet filter f. f is a vector returned by daublet or symmlet.

functions.name: idwts
functions.description: Returns the n-level inverse symmetric wavelet transform of the array a by the wavelet filter f. f is either a vector or a 2-column matrix returned by bl, Bspline, or daublet(2).

functions.name: if
functions.description: Returns x if logical condition cond is true (non-zero), y otherwise.

functions.name: ifft
functions.description: Returns the inverse Fourier transform corresponding to fft. Takes a vector of size 1 + 2^n-1, where n is an integer. Returns a real vector of size 2^n.

functions.name: IFFT
functions.description: Returns the inverse Fourier transform corresponding to FFT. Takes a vector of size 1 + 2^n-1, where n is an integer. Returns a real vector of size 2^n.

functions.name: iirhigh
functions.description: Returns coefficients for a highpass IIR filter with cutoff frequency f. The input array C is generated by one of the functions cheby1, cheby2, bessel, or butter.

functions.name: iirlow
functions.description: Returns coefficients for a lowpass IIR filter with cutoff frequency f. The input array C is generated by one of the functions cheby1, cheby2, bessel, or butter.

functions.name: iirpass
functions.description: Returns coefficients for a bandpass IIR filter with cutoff frequencies lowf and highf. The input array C is generated by one of the functions cheby1, cheby2, bessel, or butter.

functions.name: iirstop
functions.description: Returns coefficients for a bandstop IIR filter with cutoff frequencies lowf and highf. The input array C is generated by one of the functions cheby1, cheby2, bessel, or butter.

functions.name: ilct
functions.description: If w is an array of cosine packet coefficients constructed from a cosine packet table with n levels, returns the inverse cosine packet transform with respect to the basis specified by b, using data taper function f. b is a 2- or 3-column matrix representing a cosine packet basis.

functions.name: Im
functions.description: Returns the imaginary part of complex number, vector, or matrix, z.

functions.name: imhist
functions.description: Returns an n-bin histogram of M for values between 0 and 255 (ignores values outside that range).

functions.name: imhist2
functions.description: Returns an n-bin histogram of M over its range of values.

functions.name: immse
functions.description: Returns the mean-squared-error (MSE) between image matrices M and Q.

functions.name: imquant
functions.description: Returns a quantized version of matrix M containing only n equally-spaced grayscale levels between 0 and 255.

functions.name: imquant2
functions.description: Returns a quantized version of matrix M containing only the grayscale levels in vector v.

functions.name: imsnr
functions.description: Returns the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) between image matrices M and Q.

functions.name: In
functions.description: Returns the mth order modified Bessel function of the first kind.

functions.name: In.sc
functions.description: Returns the mth order modified Bessel function of the first kind, scaled by the factor exp(-|Re(z)|).

functions.name: intercept
functions.description: Returns the intercept of line that best fits data in vx and vy.

functions.name: interp
functions.description: Returns an interpolated value at x from the coefficients in vector vs, and the original data in vx and vy. Coefficient vector vs is the output of one of the following: cspline, lspline, pspline, bspline, loess, or regress.

functions.name: interpolate
functions.description: Returns an interpolated version of the vector v with n times as many points as v.

functions.name: invert
functions.description: Returns the matrix M with each element set to 255 - element.

functions.name: invert2
functions.description: Returns the matrix M with each element set to max(M) - element + min(M).

functions.name: ipmt
functions.description: Returns the interest payment of an investment or loan for a given period based on periodic, constant payments over a given number of compounding periods using a fixed interest rate and a specified present value.

functions.name: irr
functions.description: Returns the internal rate of return for a series of cash flows occurring at regular intervals.

functions.name: IsArray
functions.description: Returns 1 if x is a matrix or vector. Returns 0 otherwise.

functions.name: isintr
functions.description: Returns the inverse sine transform of the array v.

functions.name: IsNaN
functions.category: Expression Type Curve Fitting and Smoothing
functions.description: Returns 1 if x is NaN. Returns 0 otherwise.

functions.name: IsPrime
functions.description: Returns 1 if n is prime and 0 otherwise. Can only be evaluated symbolically.

functions.name: IsScalar
functions.description: Returns 1 if x is a real or complex scalar. Returns 0 otherwise.

functions.name: IsString
functions.description: Returns 1 if x is a string. Returns 0 otherwise.

functions.name: iwave
functions.description: Returns the inverse one-dimensional discrete wavelet transform of v computed using the Daubechies 4-coefficient wavelet filter in the wave function.

functions.name: iwave2d
functions.description: The n-level inverse wavelet transform of M.

functions.name: iwpt
functions.description: Returns the inverse wavelet packet transform of the array w with respect to basis b by the wavelet filter f. b is a 2- or-3-column matrix representing a packet basis. f is either a vector or a 2-column matrix. f can have an offset o and negation i.

functions.name: iwpti
functions.description: Returns the inverse interval wavelet packet transform of the array w with respect to basis b by the wavelet filter f. b is a 2- or 3-column matrix representing a packet basis. f is a vector.

functions.name: iwpts
functions.description: Returns the inverse symmetric wavelet packet transform of the array w with respect to basis b by the wavelet filter f. b is a 2- or 3-column matrix representing a packet basis. f is either a vector or a 2-column matrix.

functions.name: J0
functions.description: Returns the zeroth order Bessel function of the first kind.

functions.name: J0.sc
functions.description: Returns the zeroth order Bessel function of the first kind, scaled by exp(-|Im(z)|).

functions.name: J1
functions.description: Returns the first order Bessel function of the first kind.

functions.name: J1.sc
functions.description: Returns the first order Bessel function of the first kind, scaled by exp(-|Im(z)|).

functions.name: Jac
functions.description: Returns the value of the Jacobi polynomial of degree n at x with parameters a and b.

functions.name: Jacob
functions.description: Returns the Jacobian matrix of the vector function F(x).

functions.name: Jn
functions.description: Returns the mth order Bessel function of the first kind.

functions.name: Jn.sc
functions.description: Returns the mth order Bessel function of the first kind, scaled by exp(-|Im(z)|).

functions.name: js
functions.description: Returns the value of the spherical Bessel function of the first kind, of order m.

functions.name: K0
functions.description: Returns the zeroth order modified Bessel function of the second kind.

functions.name: K0.sc
functions.description: Returns the zeroth order modified Bessel function of the second kind, scaled by the factor exp(z).

functions.name: K1
functions.description: Returns the first order modified Bessel function of the second kind.

functions.name: K1.sc
functions.description: Returns the first order modified Bessel function of the second kind, scaled by the factor exp(z).

functions.name: kaiser
functions.description: Returns a Kaiser window of width n and parameter b.

functions.name: kendltau
functions.description: Returns Kendall's tau, number of standard deviations from 0, and the probability that a value this large or larger would occur if the samples were uncorrelated.

functions.name: kendltau2
functions.description: Returns Kendall's tau, number of standard deviations from 0, and the probability that a value this large or larger would occur if contingency table M were uncorrelated.

functions.name: kirsch
functions.description: Performs edge detection by kirsch convolution and comparison on matrix M.

functions.name: Kn
functions.description: Returns the mth order modified Bessel function of the second kind.

functions.name: Kn.sc
functions.description: Returns the mth order modified Bessel function of the second kind, scaled by the factor exp(z).

functions.name: kronecker
functions.description: Kronecker product of a square matrix M and a square matrix N.

functions.name: ksmooth
functions.description: Returns a vector of local weighted averages of vy  using a Gaussian kernel with bandwidth b.

functions.name: kurt
functions.description: Returns the kurtosis of the elements of A, B, C, ...

functions.name: Lag
functions.description: Returns the value of the Laguerre polynomial of degree n at x.

functions.name: LambertW
functions.description: Lambert(x) returns the value of the Lambert W function. Lambert(n,x) returns the value of the nth branch of the Lambert W function.

functions.name: laplace24
functions.description: Returns the convolution of matrix M with a 5x5 Laplacian kernel. The kernel's center is 24.

functions.name: laplace4
functions.description: Returns the convolution of matrix M with a 3x3 Laplacian kernel. The kernel's center is 4.

functions.name: laplace8
functions.description: Returns the convolution of matrix M with a 3x3 Laplacian kernel. The kernel's center is 8.

functions.name: last
functions.description: Returns the scalar index of the last element in vector v.

functions.name: lcm
functions.description: Returns the least common multiple: the smallest positive integer that is a multiple of all the elements of A, B, C, ...

functions.name: lcorr
functions.description: Returns a vector giving the correlation of the vectors vx and vy at each possible lag.

functions.name: lct
functions.description: Returns the n-level local cosine packet table for the data array a using data taper function f.

functions.name: LeastSquaresFit
functions.description: Returns parameters and their confidence limits for the nonlinear fitting function F for the data vx and vy, for a confidence level conf, with optional standard deviations Stdy and optional lower and upper bounds on acceptable parameter values to accuracy Acc.

functions.name: Leg
functions.description: Returns the value of the Legendre polynomial of degree n at x.

functions.name: length
functions.description: Returns the integer number of elements in vector v.

functions.name: levelmap
functions.description: Returns matrix with values in vec assigned by matching vec's indices to elements in matrix M. vec must be such that the elements of M are between 0 and length(vec) - 1.

functions.name: lgsfit
functions.description: Returns a vector containing the 3 coefficients for a logistic curve of the form a/(1+b*e^(-c*x)) that best approximates the data in vectors vx and vy, using guess values in vg.

functions.name: line
functions.description: Returns a vector containing the coefficients for a line of the form a + bx that best approximates the data in vectors vx and vy.

functions.name: linfit
functions.description: Returns a vector containing the coefficients used to create a linear combination of the functions in vector F which best approximates the data in vx and vy.

functions.name: linterp
functions.description: Returns a linearly interpolated value at x for data vectors vx and vy of the same size.

functions.name: ln
functions.description: Returns the natural logarithm (base e) of z. Returns principal value (imaginary part between pi and -pi) for complex z.

functions.name: ln0
functions.description: Returns the natural logarithm (base e) of z but allows z = 0. Returns principal value (imaginary part between pi and -pi) for complex z.

functions.name: lnfit
functions.description: Returns a vector containing the 2 coefficients for a logarithmic curve of the form a*ln(x) + b that best approximates the data in vx and vy.

functions.name: lnΓ
functions.description: Returns the natural logarithm of Euler's gamma function, evaluated at z. To type G, press G[Ctrl]G.

functions.name: LoadColormap
functions.description: Returns an array containing the values in the colormap named file.

functions.name: loadings
functions.description: Returns the loadings of the principal components (eigenvalues) from multivariate data returned by the nipals function.

functions.name: localmax
functions.description: Returns the local maxima in data by nearest neighbor comparison, with an optional window width w of comparison points.

functions.name: localmin
functions.description: Returns the local minima in data by nearest neighbor comparison, with an optional window width w of comparison points.

functions.name: loess
functions.description: Returns a vector used by the interp function to find a set of second order polynomials that best fit a neighborhood of data values in vectors or matrices vx and vy. The size of the neighborhood is controlled by span.

functions.name: log
functions.description: Returns the base b logarithm of z. If b is omitted, returns the base 10 logarithm.

functions.name: logfit
functions.description: Returns a vector containing the three coefficients for a logarithmic curve of the form a*ln(x+b)+c that best approximates the data in vectors vx and vy. Vector vg contains guess values for the three coefficients.

functions.name: LogNormal
functions.description: Returns a vector of n random numbers having the standard log normal distribution.

functions.name: logpts
functions.description: Returns a vector with dec decades of evenly-spaced points starting at 10 raised to the exponent minexp, with dnpts points per decade.

functions.name: logspace
functions.description: Returns a vector of npts logarithmically-spaced points starting at min, ending at max.

functions.name: Lookup
functions.description: Looks in the matrix A for values matched by z according to the boolean modifier. Returns the value(s) in the same position(s) in matrix B.

functions.name: lookup
functions.description: Looks in a vector or matrix, A, for a given value, z, and returns the value(s) in the same position(s) (i.e., with the same row and column numbers) in another matrix, B. When multiple values are returned, they appear in a vector.

functions.name: lowpass
functions.description: Returns coefficients for a lowpass FIR filter with n coefficients and cutoff frequency f, windowed with taper w.

functions.name: lsolve
functions.description: Returns the vector x solving the linear system of equations M*x = v.

functions.name: lspline
functions.description: Returns a vector of cubic spline coefficients with linear  endpoints which fits the independent data in vector or matrix vx and dependent data in vy. This vector becomes the first argument of the interp function.

functions.name: lu
functions.description: Returns a matrix containing three augmented square matrices P, L, and U, all having the same size as M; these satisfy the equation P M = L U.

functions.name: mag
functions.description: Returns a vector containing the magnitudes of the elements in the complex array v.

functions.name: makeri
functions.description: Returns a vector of complex numbers whose magnitudes and phases are contained in magvec and phasevec.

functions.name: markNaN
functions.description: Changes each element in data specified by vindex to contain a NaN.

functions.name: mask
functions.description: Returns matrix M masked by same-size matrix N (i.e. with zeros where N is zero).

functions.name: Match
functions.description: Returns the indices of entries in A which match z according to the boolean modifier.

functions.name: match
functions.description: Looks in a vector or matrix, A, for a given value, z, and returns the index (indices) of its positions in A.

functions.name: matchNaN
functions.description: Returns the index or pair of indexes of the NaN entries in data.

functions.name: matconv
functions.description: Convolution of matrix M with frequency domain mask N.

functions.name: matdeconv
functions.description: Deconvolution of matrix M with frequency domain mask N and error e.

functions.name: matrix
functions.description: Returns a m x n matrix in which the ijth element is given by f(i,j).

functions.name: max
functions.description: Returns the largest value from A, B, C, ... If any value is complex, returns max(Re(A, B, C, ...)) + i*max(Im(A, B, C, ...)).

functions.name: Maximize
functions.description: Returns the values of var1, var2, ..., that satisfy the constraints in a Solve Block, and make the function f take on its greatest value. Returns a scalar if there is only one argument, otherwise returns a vector of answers.

functions.name: mean
functions.description: Returns the arithmetic mean, or average, of the elements of A, B, C, ...

functions.name: medfilt
functions.description: Returns median filtered M.

functions.name: medfilt1d
functions.description: Returns the multichannel signal M, filtered with a median filter of length n.

functions.name: medfit
functions.description: Returns a vector containing the coefficients for a line of the form a + bx that best approximates the data in vectors vx and vy using median-median regression.

functions.name: median
functions.description: Returns the median of the elements of A, B, C ...

functions.name: medsmooth
functions.description: Returns a smoothed vector by replacing each value in vy with the median of the n points centered on that value.

functions.name: mhyper
functions.description: Returns the value of the confluent hypergeometric function, M(a,b,x), at the point x with parameters a and b.

functions.name: min
functions.description: Returns the smallest value in A, B, C, ... If any value is complex, returns min(Re(A, B, C, ...)) + i*min(Im(A, B, C, ...)).

functions.name: Minerr
functions.description: Returns the values of var1, var2, ..., coming closest to satisfying a system of equations and constraints in a Solve Block. Returns a scalar if only one argument, otherwise returns a vector of answers. If Minerr cannot converge, it returns the results of the last iteration.

functions.name: Minimize
functions.description: Returns the values of var1, var2, ..., that satisfy the constraints in a Solve Block, and make the function f take on its smallest value. Returns a scalar if there is only one variable, otherwise returns a vector of answers.

functions.name: mirr
functions.description: Returns the modified internal rate of return for a vector v of cash flows given a finance rate and a reinvestment rate.

functions.name: mod
functions.description: Returns the remainder on dividing x by y (x modulo y).  Result has the same sign as x.

functions.name: mode
functions.description: Returns the value in A, B, C, ... that occurs most often.

functions.name: moment_invariant
functions.description: Returns a vector containing the seven typical moment invariants of M.

functions.name: montecarlo
functions.description: Returns n Monte Carlo samples created by calculating function F for variables randomly generated given the information found in matrix Rvals.

functions.name: mother
functions.description: Returns the value at x of the mother wavelet packet based on the filter represented by string s at scale j and position k. If j and k are omitted, they are assumed to be 0.

functions.name: mother2d
functions.params: x, y, [j, kx, ky], s, ds
functions.description: Returns the value at (x,y) of the 2D mother wavelet packet based on the filter represented by string s at scale j and position (kx,ky). String ds is either "H", "V", or "D", and indicates either the horizontal, vertical, or diagonal wavelet. If j, kx, and ky are omitted, they are assumed to be 0.

functions.name: movavg
functions.description: Returns a smoothed version of data in array v created by taking a moving average with a window of width n.

functions.name: mtaguchi
functions.description: Returns a mixed Taguchi design matrix with n1 factors of l1 levels and n2 factors of l2 levels.

functions.name: multidfit
functions.description: Returns the multivariate fit parameters for an arbitrary function F fitting the results recorded in matrix Y to the data found in matrix X.

functions.name: multigrid
functions.description: Returns a square matrix of solution values for Poisson's partial differential equation, controlled by ncycle, in the case of zero boundaries.  Otherwise, use the relax function.

functions.name: multirate
functions.description: Returns a version of multichannel signal v resampled by a factor of n/m, using the optional argument f as the lowpass interpolating filter.

functions.name: Nipals
functions.description: Returns numPC principal components (eigenvalues), loadings, scores, and accumulated variance explained by each PC from multivariate data using a maximum of maxiter iterations. TOL specifies the termination accuracy used for eigenvalue generation. Data may be optionally scaled to the standard deviation.

functions.name: Nipals2
functions.description: Returns numPC additional principal components (eigenvalues), loadings, scores, and accumulated variance explained by each PC given the results calculated by Nipals.

functions.name: nom
functions.description: Returns the nominal interest rate, given the effective annual interest rate (APR) and the number of compounding periods per year.

functions.name: norm1
functions.description: Returns the L1 norm of the matrix M.

functions.name: norm2
functions.description: Returns the L2 norm of the matrix M.

functions.name: Normal
functions.description: Returns a vector of n random numbers having the standard normal distribution.

functions.name: norme
